body.title: Schedule $6,800 payment to the Chase credit card
body.why: The plan recommends an initial payment to reduce the high-rate card: "The first move is paying $6,800 on the 18% card from cash. The published score moves from 60 to 62, leaving $11,200 total after the move."
body.action: Confirm available accessible cash and schedule a $6,800 payment from a cash account to the Chase CC to reduce the outstanding balance to $11,200; record the payment in your cash plan.

tasks.title: Confirm accessible cash and intended funding account
Schedule the $6,800 payment to Chase CC
Update your budget and cash plan
